Owner review 2026-09-14: the day-grouped logbook does not scale (a header per entry when the mode is one weigh-in/day; unbounded list — full-history query + plain Column composition). Agreed IA:

1. **Weight surface — compressed History card.** One row per bucket, the further back the coarser: each day for the last 7 days, then 4 weeks (Mon–Sun), then 4 months, then quarter by quarter (cap 12 quarters). Bucket row: range label, weigh-in count (when >1), delta vs the previous bucket, end-of-bucket day's weight (lowest-of-day, the existing canonical). Empty buckets inside the range show "—" — gaps are data. Buckets older than the earliest entry are not rendered. Rows tap through to the full logbook.
2. **New full-page Logbook (f06/logbook).** Every verbatim entry, newest first, sticky month headers ("SEPTEMBER 2026 · 14 weigh-ins · −1.1 kg"), self-describing rows ("Sun 14 · 06:30 … 77.0 kg" — no month on the row, it lives in the header), windowed feed: latest 3 months, "Load earlier (N more)" appends older chunks; bounded kind-filtered queries + LazyColumn.
3. **Delete UX (WLO-0050) moves to the full logbook** — swipe-to-reveal on verbatim rows, release-gated, visible arm affordance, inline undo with visible countdown. Aggregate buckets are not deletable.
4. Tier constants are tunable; kg formatting stays until WLO-0052 globalizes units.
text:
Implemented 2026-09-14 — uncommitted in the tree, pending the owner's test (same round of testing as WLO-0050's countdown build; the emulator keeps its current build until then).

**What shipped**
- Weight surface: the day-grouped Logbook card is replaced by a **History card** (`f06-history-card`) — one row per bucket, coarser with distance: 7 daily rows, 4 Mon–Sun weeks, 4 calendar months, then quarters (12-quarter cap). Bucket rows: range label, weigh-in count (>1), signed Δ vs the previous bucket, closing day's weight (lowest-of-day); empty buckets keep their row ("—"); tier captions mark the compression; rows + a "Full logbook" button open the new screen.
- New **full-page logbook** (`f06/logbook`): every verbatim entry, newest first, sticky month headers carrying the month + its facts ("SEPTEMBER 2026 · 14 weigh-ins · −1.1 kg"); rows are self-describing without the month ("Today · 06:30 … 77.0 kg"). Feed windowed: latest 3 months + "Load earlier (N more)" chunks; the "N more" is a real kind-filtered COUNT query, not a guess. LazyColumn throughout.
- **WLO-0050's delete door moved here** (aggregate buckets are not deletable): WloSwipeRevealRow per row — release-gated, velocity ignored, visible arm affordance — plus the inline undo with the visible countdown hairline and slide-away exit, exactly as approved.
- Data layer: `MeasurementRepository.rangeOfKind` + `countOfKind` (bounded windowed reads replace the full-history sweep on this surface).

**Tests/gates**: new `WeightHistoryTest` (tier boundaries, lowest-of-day, delta chaining across tiers, empty-bucket gaps, tiling without overlap, floor math, labels); `M3WeighInTest` updated — verbatim assertions and the swipe-delete flow now run on the logbook screen. ktlint (main + androidTest), all unit tests, `:app:assembleDebug`, androidTest compile all green.

**Known limitations, deliberate**: single-slot undo (a second delete replaces the first's undo window — flagged for the owner); kg-only formatting until WLO-0052; jump-to-month deferred until "Load earlier" chains feel long.

text: Owner review round 1 (2026-09-15): the logbook feed lacked M3 list metrics — rows were hand-rolled opaque slabs with content flush to the edges, date+time run together, and the revealed Delete action didn't align with the value column. Fix: the row is now the standard material3 ListItem (56 dp one-line metrics, 16 dp inner edges) inside the unchanged WloSwipeRevealRow wrapper; date is the headline with time/markers as supporting spans, the weight sits in ListItem's trailing slot; container color = the page's own color so rows read flat with hairline WloStatDivider rhythm between items; month header got proper bottom separation. The Delete strip's 16 dp trailing inset now matches ListItem's trailing inset, so the action lands exactly under the value column. Verified on the emulator (installed via `adb install -r`, data kept); gates re-run green.

text: Owner review round 2 (2026-09-15): the revealed Delete action sat TOP-aligned in the row, not centered. Root cause in WloSwipeRevealRow itself: the action strip used fillMaxHeight against a parent that never bounds height (lazy containers measure children unbounded), so the strip collapsed to its content height and top-aligned. Fix: the strip layer is now Modifier.matchParentSize() — sized to the content's actual height — with the reveal Box centered in it. Verified mid-drag on the emulator: Delete is vertically centered and right-aligned under the value column; arm affordance and spring-back unchanged. Installed via `adb install -r`.
